status: rough blocking for review; no design or runtime approval implied
direction: Paper theatre: oxide factory, chalk polis, malachite housing, ochre exterior. Fixed texture; deliberate held poses; mouthless avatars.

assets.HALL-01: Five vertical stone ribs, a narrow central opening, low three-step forecourt
assets.GEM-01: Uneven six-sided emerald prism with a pale diagonal inclusion; provisional cord around narrow waist
assets.CHILD-01: Chalk-grey, yellow eyes, broad head, mouthless; storytelling with both hands
assets.WORKER-01: Slumped, oxide apron, large hands; gesture geometry shared with CHILD-01
assets.DAUGHTER-01: Clearly adult, clothed in ochre wrap; initial withdrawal precedes fascination

board.title: An ordinary workday
board.note: Lever. Clipboard. Clock. Let the routine become believable before the first voice.

board.title: A story breaks its own rules
board.note: One objection, one rewrite. Duplicate worker, vanishing door, timer, yellow eyes.

board.title: The tellers
board.note: Matched hands reveal the child. Where is everybody? The elder leads them onward.

board.title: One person first
board.note: Proposed ordinary life: a shared table, then an empty chair. One scream; leave it alone briefly.

board.title: One becomes billions
board.note: Voices gather. Withdraw from the Hall; its world resolves into an emerald facet.

board.title: The housing in the Earth
board.note: The simulation has no tunnel to the rock. Folded strata carry the jewel through deep time.

board.title: A living, empty surface
board.note: Ice retreats; plants return. No large animals visible during the coming visit.

board.title: The same question
board.note: Visitors pause. Fictional language, one English subtitle: Where is everybody? They leave.

board.title: Life returns across vast time
board.note: After the ship leaves: successive animal eras, then humans. Mechanism and dates remain unstated.

board.title: Something survives
board.note: Erosion exposes the same emerald. A rough human hand retrieves it.

board.title: The exchange
board.note: Demand, resistance, withdrawal. Only then the jewel captures the adult daughter's attention.

board.title: The witnesses
board.note: Clothed daughter and necklace; unmoving crowd. Party, infant, remembered screams, silence.

dialogue.speaker: storyteller
dialogue.text: They kept one human to finish the work.

dialogue.speaker: challenger
dialogue.text: Why didn't they do it themselves?

dialogue.speaker: storyteller
dialogue.text: Robots weren't allowed to kill people.

dialogue.speaker: challenger
dialogue.text: But they made him do it.

dialogue.speaker: challenger
dialogue.text: You said there was only one.

dialogue.speaker: challenger
dialogue.text: Then why did they need the man?

dialogue.speaker: storyteller
dialogue.text: The timer wasn't allowed to kill people either.
